quotes.text: Save this message to your drafts folder ({ $folder })
attribute AUTF8String fccFolderURI; // A.K.A. Sent Mail

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The landing replaces synchronous draft-folder creation in ComposeCanClose with a default Drafts name and an optional existing-folder lookup. That lookup uses fccFolderURI, which nsIMsgIdentity documents as Sent Mail, while draftsFolderURI is a separate attribute. The resulting name fills text that calls it the drafts folder, and the Save branch still initiates AutoSaveAsDraft. Thus a differently named existing Sent folder supplies the displayed Drafts label in this path. The mismatch remains in fixed accepted source, although localization later moved to Fluent; no native dialog, folder creation or data-loss result was exercised.
title: The async-folder removal leaves the Drafts prompt label sourced from the Sent folder URI
